legal.privacy.controller.description: The data controller is the owner or manager of the virtual gallery to which the request is sent.
legal.privacy.controller.thirdPartyNote: Note: if the portal is used by third-party gallery owners, each gallery owner may act as an independent controller for requests received through their own gallery.
legal.privacy.controller.title: 1. Data Controller
legal.privacy.data.dateTime: date and time of the request;
legal.privacy.data.galleryOrArtwork: gallery or artwork for which information is requested;
legal.privacy.data.intro: Through public forms, the following data may be collected:

legal.privacy.data.userAgent: technical user agent of the browser;
legal.privacy.header.description: This privacy notice describes how personal data sent through information request forms within the virtual galleries on the portal are processed.
legal.privacy.header.label: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.header.title: Privacy Policy on Personal Data Processing.
legal.privacy.importantNote.description: This page is an operational draft for the MVP. Before the official publication of the service, the text must be verified and adapted to the actual legal entity, the suppliers actually used, the final retention periods, and any marketing, analytics or payment integrations.
legal.privacy.importantNote.title: Important Note
legal.privacy.legalBasis.description: The processing of data sent via the form is necessary to follow up on the user’s request, including in the pre-contractual phase, and for the legitimate interest of the controller to properly manage the contacts received and prevent abuses.
legal.privacy.legalBasis.marketingConsen: Any sending of promotional communications or newsletters, if activated in the future, will require a separate and optional consent.
legal.privacy.legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis
legal.privacy.processing.description: Data are processed with IT tools and organized within the portal to allow the gallery owner to read, manage, archive, export or delete the requests received.
legal.privacy.processing.externalService: The portal uses external technical services for hosting, database, storage, and possible transactional email sending.
legal.privacy.processing.title: 5. Methods of Processing
legal.privacy.purposes.commercialNegotia: manage any commercial negotiations or pre-contractual requests;
legal.privacy.purposes.contactUser: re-contact the user regarding the indicated gallery or artwork;
legal.privacy.purposes.documentConsent: document consent and acceptance of the privacy policy.
legal.privacy.purposes.preventAbuse: preventing abuse, spam, or improper use of the form;
legal.privacy.purposes.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
legal.privacy.recipients.description: Data may be processed by technical providers necessary for the operation of the service, such as hosting platforms, databases, storage, authentication, and transactional email.
legal.privacy.recipients.noSale: Data is not sold to third parties. It is not used for marketing without separate consent.
legal.privacy.recipients.title: 6. Recipients and Technical Providers
legal.privacy.retention.description: Requests are retained for as long as necessary to manage the contact, the negotiation, or any commercial relationship. In the absence of further relations, the requests may be deleted or anonymized after a reasonable period.
legal.privacy.retention.mvpDeletion: At this MVP stage, deletion can be carried out by the gallery owner via the request dashboard.
legal.privacy.retention.title: 7. Data Retention
legal.privacy.rights.complaint: The user may also file a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.
legal.privacy.rights.description: The user can request access to their data, rectification, deletion, restriction of processing, objection to processing, and, where applicable, data portability.
legal.privacy.rights.title: 8. Data Subject Rights
legal.privacy.transfers.description: Some technical providers might process data outside the European Economic Area. In such cases, processing must occur based on adequate safeguards provided by applicable law.
legal.privacy.transfers.title: 9. Transfers outside the EEA
